dct_description_sm: Underway temperature and salinity data was collected along the cruise track with two autonomous measurement systems. Usually, the systems are changed after 6 hours. While temperature is taken at the water inlet in about 6.5 m depth, salinity is estimated within the interior measurement container from conductivity and interior temperature. No temperature and salinity calibration were performed. For details to all processing steps see Data Processing Report.
dct_subject_sm: Calculated from internal temperature and conductivity
